content.text: In the quarterfinals, Zambia will encounter the champions of Group B, which could lead to an exciting showdown with Nigeria, contingent on the nine-time Wafcon champions not losing to Algeria this Sunday at 19:00 GMT.
On Sunday, Nigeria will compete against Algeria, while Tunisia will battle Botswana in the final round of group fixtures, with both matches scheduled to start at 19:00 GMT.
Mali currently has four points from four matches, while South Africa is competing against Tanzania, where the defending champion possesses the strength to secure victory and qualify.
